description: Defines the RenderedView class used for representing and manipulating a view hierarchy in Android rendering tools, including methods for finding views by tag, position, and hierarchy traversal.

classes.name: RenderedView
classes.description: Represents a view in the Android rendering hierarchy, with position, size, parent/child relationships, and tag information.

methods.name: x2
methods.description: Returns the x-coordinate of the right edge of the view.

methods.name: y2
methods.description: Returns the y-coordinate of the bottom edge of the view.

methods.name: setChildren
methods.description: Sets the list of child RenderedViews.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns the list of child RenderedViews, or an empty list if none.

methods.name: findViewByTag
methods.description: Recursively searches for a view with the specified XmlTag.

methods.name: findViewsByTag
methods.description: Recursively finds all views with the specified XmlTag.

methods.name: findLeafAt
methods.description: Finds the topmost leaf view at the given pixel coordinates.

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Determines if this view is a root view.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the child views.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the bounding rectangle of the view.
